In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. 3. This medication is prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes unless directed by your healthcare provider. 4. While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests, such as stool samples and kidney function assessments, may be required to monitor your progress and detect potential side effects. 5. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. 6. Store this medication in a refrigerator, away from light and moisture. Do not freeze it. Discard any unused medication after 14 days. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard expired or no longer needed medication. 7. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. 9. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether this form of vancomycin passes into breast milk. Consult your healthcare provider for guidance. 10.
